name: bn-llm-benchmark
description: A Bengali-focused multi-task LLM benchmark dataset collecting a variety of tasks in the Bengali language to evaluate language models' capabilities (e.g., classification, QA, translation and generation). It aims to measure Bengali-language understanding and generation across diverse prompt types and task formats. Task-dependent metrics are used for evaluation.
evaluation_method: task-dependent (accuracy / exact_match / BLEU / F1 as appropriate)
general_score_metric: task-dependent (accuracy or exact_match for classification/QA, BLEU for translation)
reputation: An emerging community benchmark for Bengali LLM evaluation hosted on Hugging Face, used by regional NLP researchers and practitioners.
